LESSON: READING 6.4.1 ORAL LITERATURE: SONGS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are songs similar to poems?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to audio recordings of lullabies,

2. view videos of lullabies and identify instances of repetition,

3. perform a lullaby and make a recording,

4. pick out key messages communicated in lullabies,

5. share ideas on the key messages that are addressed in lullabies,

6. discuss the functions of lullabies,

7. collaborate to compose songs, sing and record lullabies from their immediate environment,

8. work with peers to create lullabies and perform them in class,

9. identify characters in different lullabies.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to audio recordings of lullabies,
2. view videos of lullabies and identify instances of repetition,
3. perform a lullaby and make a recording,
4. pick out key messages communicated in lullabies,
5. share ideas on the key messages that are addressed in lullabies,
6. discuss the functions of lullabies,
7. collaborate to compose songs, sing and record lullabies from their immediate environment,
8. work with peers to create lullabies and perform them in class,
9. identify characters in different lullabies.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.4.1 Oral literature: Songs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: It is developed as the learner creates lullabies.

• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner researches information about lullabies.

Values:
Social justice is achieved as the learner fosters inclusivity while collaborating with peers in singing and recording lullabies from

their immediate environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Healthy relationship is developed as the learner collaborates in singing and recording lullabies from their immediate

environment.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates performing of lullabies to other learning areas such as Creative Arts and Sports.
